items.title: Lakebase streaming sink is generally available
items.text: The Lakebase streaming sink is generally available. It now supports Trigger.AvailableNow() on serverless jobs and notebooks. In Databricks Runtime 19 and above, it also supports merge strategies and additive schema evolution ( mergeSchema ). Writing to an external PostgreSQL database through a Unity Catalog connection is in Public Preview. See Connect to Lakebase.

items.id: November_18_2026#Feature: Lakehouse supports BigQuery row-level security and column-level security with dynamic data masking on Apache Iceberg tables in the Lakehouse runtime catalog ( GA ).
items.title: Lakehouse supports BigQuery row-level security and column-level security with dynamic data masking on Apache Iceberg tables in the Lakehouse runtime catalog ( GA )
items.text: Lakehouse supports BigQuery row-level security and column-level security with dynamic data masking on Apache Iceberg tables in the Lakehouse runtime catalog ( GA ). You can restrict which rows principals can see and mask sensitive column values by managing these policies with GoogleSQL DDL statements in BigQuery. On catalogs that use credential vending mode, the Apache Iceberg REST catalog endpoint vends storage credentials only to principals that have unmasked access to every protected column and, if the table has row-level access policies, unfiltered row access.
